subtitle: Light data pull: 8 quarters of revenue, operating profit and net profit (no narrative report)
limitations: Older quarters come from a secondary data aggregator (StockAnalysis) and were not individually checked against Kia filings.
The aggregator does not say whether net income is attributable to the parent or total.
Light data pull only: no valuation, no opinion, no fact-check pass, no DART/SEC body or notes review beyond what is listed under sources.

Q2 2026 matches Just Auto (revenue 33,037bn, operating profit 2,628.5bn, net income 2,327.8bn). Two Korean-news outlets print revenue as 33.37tn, which is inconsistent with their own +12.6% YoY and 8.0% margin, so it is treated as a typo.

summary.text: Kia Corporation reported 2026-Q2 revenue of KRW 33,037.1bn and operating profit of KRW 2,628.6bn (margin 8.0%). Q2 2026 matches Just Auto (revenue 33,037bn, operating profit 2,628.5bn, net income 2,327.8bn). Two Korean-news outlets print revenue as 33.37tn, which is inconsistent with their own +12.6% YoY and 8.0% margin, so it is treated as a typo.
